items.title: Mitel OpenScape命令注入RCE
items.summary_zh: Platform组件参数过滤不足，攻击者可注入命令并以系统权限执行任意指令
items.action_zh: 跟进厂商补丁升级，临时限制Platform组件接口暴露
items.repro_note: 向Platform组件参数注入命令分隔符，观察系统执行
items.impact_scope: 企业语音/UC平台，多暴露于内网
items.description: A vulnerability in the Platform component of Mitel OpenScape 4000 and OpenScape 4000 Manager could allow an attacker to conduct a command injection attack due to insufficient parameter sanitization. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands within the context of the system.

items.title: RealVNC UDP越界写入未认证RCE
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者经UDP连接触发越界写入，可远程执行代码或造成拒绝服务
items.action_zh: 升级至 7.19.1 及以上；无需UDP连接时禁用该模式
items.repro_note: 向RealVNC服务UDP端口发送畸形连接数据包触发越界写入
items.impact_scope: 远程桌面服务端，常暴露网络
items.description: In RealVNC Server before 7.19.1, UDP-based connections could potentially be exploited without authentication to execute code remotely or cause the software to crash. This could allow an attacker to remotely execute code as root on certain platforms or perform a denial of service attack.

items.title: OpenScape 4000未授权访问漏洞
items.summary_zh: 认证机制缺陷致未授权攻击者可获取敏感信息并非授权访问系统
items.action_zh: 升级至厂商修复版本；临时限制管理面暴露并加强访问控制
items.repro_note: 直接访问Platform组件受保护接口，验证无需凭据即可获取数据
items.impact_scope: 企业语音/UC平台，多暴露于内网
items.description: A vulnerability in the Platform component of Mitel OpenScape 4000, and OpenScape 4000 Manager could allow an unauthenticated attacker to conduct an unauthorized access attack due to improper authentication mechanisms. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to obtain sensitive information and gain unauthorized access to system.

items.title: 多租户RPC服务认证绕过可冒充管理员
items.title_zh: 多租户RPC服务认证绕过可冒充管理员
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者可伪造任意用户（含管理员）会话，跨租户读写业务数据
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复信息时限制服务暴露，等待厂商补丁升级
items.repro_note: 向RPC接口提交伪造会话凭据，验证越权调用已认证方法
items.impact_scope: 多租户后端服务，横向越权
items.description: When the check passes, Ping stores an attacker-chosen session ID, user number and company in the server session store, and subsequent session validation accepts that session. An unauthenticated remote attacker can therefore create a valid session as any user, including administrators, in any company (tenant) hosted on the server and invoke authenticated RPC methods with that user's privileges, gaining read and write access to that company's data.
